title: Development and validation of a habitat-based radiomics fusion model for predicting immunotherapy response in advanced NSCLC: a multicenter retrospective study.
summary: A habitat-based radiomics fusion model predicted immunotherapy response in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer across multicenter retrospective cohorts, with the data, comparison and evaluation reported in the full text. Interpretation stays with the reported study; no broader clinical benefit follows.
